setup: if command -v industriconnect-setup >/dev/null 2>&1; then industriconnect-setup; else python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codeflow/verification/run.py" setup; fi
check: if command -v industriconnect-check >/dev/null 2>&1; then industriconnect-check; else python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codeflow/verification/run.py" check; fi

run.command: cd mcp-manager-ui && ./node_modules/.bin/concurrently --kill-others --names UI,API 'npm run dev:frontend -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" --strictPort' 'PORT=3003 npm run dev:backend'
